resources.string:
For records with fields one chooses, each found by its name: foods and their calories, books, plants, contacts.
## What it does
- Other tools can name a record, like a meal naming its foods
- Importing a table
## Not made for
- What is noted over time (Tracking, Journal)

## The records
A record has a name, plus the tool's fields, added in the common settings.

## The table
- Columns of the table: how many fields show after the name

## The table
- Search by name
- Filters
Touch a column's title to sort by it, and touch it again to reverse the order.
- {plus} New record
- Import a file: a CSV table, one row per record

## A record
Touch a row to open its record.
- {chevron-left} Previous record
- {chevron-right} Next record
- Change
- {trash} Deletes the record
The fields you choose, each record found by its name, for foods, books, plants or anything else
How many of the user\'s fields (extra_fields, in their order) the table shows after the name
The record\'s name, unique in the tool: what finds it, and what a reference to it shows
The record\'s columns: each of its values is one of the user\'s fields
